title: Prop tables and interfaces disagree with the components they document
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists
details:
- `components/SegmentedControl.md:32` prints the props interface without the `Omit` the code carries at `src/components/SegmentedControl.tsx:15`. `Omit<..., "onChange">` is load bearing, so a reader who copies the printed interface to wrap the component hits a type error the document does not warn about.
- `components/FormGroup.md:29` declares `label` required. `src/components/FormGroup.tsx:15` declares it optional, and the comment above it documents the unlabelled composite-control case the specification never mentions.
- `components/AppShell.md:43` says `titleHref` defaults to `/`. `src/components/AppShell.tsx:35` defaults it to `null` and renders an inert `<span>`. The document contradicts itself at `:44`.
- `components/CardGroup.md:90` prints the context value as `maximizedId` and `toggle`. `src/components/CardGroupContext.ts` also carries `fill`.
- `components/SplitPane.md:80` describes a collapsed pane as zero width with hidden overflow. `src/components/SplitPane.tsx:165` returns null, so its children and their state leave the DOM.
- `components/MarkdownMinimap.md:49` gives content blocks a 1px minimum. `MarkdownMinimap.tsx:70` floors every block at 2px first, and the same document says 2px at `:99`.
- `components/CodeBlock.md:58` gives the root `display: flex`. `src/styles/components/code-block.css:10` applies that to a class `CodeBlock.tsx:178` adds only in `fillHeight` mode.
- `components/EventLanes.md:254` describes a two-tone viewport window. `src/components/EventLanes.tsx:613` draws a single stroked rectangle, and the comment above it records the removal.
- `components/FormGroup.md:81` says `error` is forwarded to every child. `FormGroup.tsx:76` forwards it only to component children, never to a native element.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.
